search_audit.query: 刀 到 Mandarin dāo dào Taiwan Ministry Education dictionary; site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File: 刀-seal.svg Wikimedia Commons
search_audit.outcome: Search found official Ministry of Education dictionary entries for both readings and the exact Commons file page. Opened and inspected the dictionary entries, Commons description page, the linked Xiaoxuetang record, and its CC0 rights notice.

gaps: The official Unicode Unihan character records were not checked in this invocation. Modern reading evidence here is instead from the opened Ministry of Education dictionary pages; the supplied local Unihan rows remain local corroboration only.

The checked local Baxter–Sagart rows retain their prior provenance and notation: 刀 MC taw, OC *C.tˤaw; 到 MC tawH, OC *tˤaw[k]-s. The authors’ character-specific PDF was not newly opened in this invocation; their historical comparison remains distinct from the newly verified modern Mandarin comparison. The existing dossier records its PDF access failure.
The selected image depicts 刀 and supports identification of the phonetic component only. It does not depict 到 or resolve the competing graphic-history accounts for 到.

limitations.text: This seal-style rendering depicts 刀, not 到. It cannot resolve the competing accounts of 到’s older graphic form or establish a chronology for its development.
